# Third-party research snapshots

These shallow source snapshots were downloaded to evaluate reuse options. They are not application dependencies and must not be imported into the runtime build by default.

| Folder | Upstream | License | Snapshot commit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `postiz-app/` | https://github.com/gitroomhq/postiz-app | AGPL-3.0 | `bd8353f09f8dbaec54f15985f26d34b56ac69636` |
| `social-media-skills/` | https://github.com/charlie947/social-media-skills | MIT | `10ca79c0ec0be0f7654d19cd4f0c86b6fa6ed23b` |
| `MultiPost-Extension/` | https://github.com/leaperone/MultiPost-Extension | Apache-2.0 snapshot; official extension also includes an unpublished proprietary module | `5522ca01100a58572de3a652aebd7851f5fa648a` |
| `personal-social-agent/` | https://github.com/ansaribilal14/personal-social-agent | MIT | `88541f832e395f92d3566b6eb4d30c4382c7a5bd` |
| `scalepilot-autopost/` | https://github.com/nikopastore/scalepilot-autopost | MIT | `e79e6572e406ee8066c5e1ce662c68753ea77b01` |
| `chrome-extensions-samples/api-samples/tabs/screenshot/` | https://github.com/GoogleChrome/chrome-extensions-samples | Apache-2.0 | `b7d8bebb00bb11191126c6abbe471ec5f79c4feb` |
| `fast-redact/` | https://github.com/davidmarkclements/fast-redact | MIT | `e268c1c3b5a3be770f8082583f626bc4ba5c648d` |

Review [`GITHUB_REUSE_REVIEW.md`](../../docs/research/GITHUB_REUSE_REVIEW.md) and the [follow-up batch notes](../../docs/research/github-batches/README.md) before using any source. Do not run dependency installation, build, or setup scripts from these snapshots as part of the Social Base app.
